How to use
JIO PAY
Video dekho: wallet link karna aur deposit karna
Step by step
1

Tools par jao, Link Wallet dabao

Neeche bar me Tools kholo. Wahan + Link Wallet button dabao. Pehle wallet link karna zaroori hai, tabhi deposit hoga.

2

UPI tool chuno aur number daalo

Select UPI list me MobikwikWeb (ya jo tool aapke paas ho) chuno. Us tool me jo 10-digit phone number registered hai wo daalo aur Start linking dabao.

3

Verify karo, wallet link ho jayega

Verification complete hote hi “Wallet linked successfully” aayega aur Wallet List me aapka wallet Online dikhega. Chaho to ek se zyada wallet link kar sakte ho.

4

Deposit me order chuno

Neeche Deposit kholo, ₹ INR Orders → Available me jao. Amount range ya filter se apna order dhundo aur uske saamne Buy / Pay dabao.

5

Pay Tool select karo

Select Tool popup aayega. Apna linked wallet chuno aur Use dabao.

6

Market Detail me payment karo

Order ka amount, Payer Name, Bank Name, Bank Account, IFSC aur Remark dikhega. Copy icon se details copy karo aur 30:00 minute ke andar exact amount bhej do. Galti ho to Cancel Order ya Change Pay Tool use kar sakte ho.

7

UTR daalo

Payment hone ke baad niche Payment UTR box me apna UTR number daalo aur submit karo.

8

Status check karo

In Progress me order Pending dikhega. Confirm hote hi wo Completed me Success ke saath aa jayega. Puri list Deposit History me dekh sakte ho, aur nikasi ki history Withdrawal History me.

💡 Tip: Payment hamesha usi amount ka karo jo order me likha hai, aur timer (30:00) khatam hone se pehle UTR daal do.
